en.creative.off-script.deck: A fictional figure, a mirror, and a reflection that refuses to follow.

en.creative.just-one-thing.title: Just One Thing
en.creative.just-one-thing.deck: An everyday sidewalk becomes the stage for a receipt that keeps going.

en.creative.just-one-thing.method: Scale does the storytelling: familiar pavement meets an absurd ribbon of printed paper.
en.creative.critical-charge.title: Critical Charge

en.creative.no-comment.deck: Black tailoring meets a surface of paper comments and redactions.
en.creative.no-comment.idea: A black tailored look is covered with paper strips bearing comments and deliberate redactions.

en.creative.soft-glass.idea: The rigid screen separates from a phone and bends like a thin sheet of glass.
en.creative.soft-glass.method: The concept hinges on a material contradiction: a familiar display behaving like a flexible membrane.

en.creative.drag-to-direct.method: A simple drag gesture gives the cursor physical presence and lets it steer light across the playing surface.

en.dc.label: SPECULATIVE CAMPAIGN / FIVE FRAMES
en.dc.heading: There’s more after the hook.
en.dc.description: DEEP CUT is a fictional record club for full attention. A campaign that turns a fleeting hook into the pleasure of listening to a whole side.
en.dc.disclosure: Fictional brand · Speculative campaign by BYMOU. AI photographic elements; original typography, identity and layouts.
en.dc.deck: From the first hook to the last groove. Five distinct compositions for a fictional record club.
en.dc.swipe: Swipe, use the arrows or focus the carousel and press ← →.
en.dc.premise: Less skipping. More getting lost in it.
en.dc.context: The idea starts with a familiar habit: hearing the hook and moving on. DEEP CUT invites the opposite. Give a record a whole side, and let curiosity do the rest.
en.dc.sequence: A sequence with a reason to swipe.
en.dc.fullsize: Open a slide to inspect the full-size SVG.
en.dc.systemText: A sleeve becomes a stage for the hook. A groove becomes a label. A circular crop follows a hand into the record bin. Then photography gives way to a listening ritual and a full brand reveal. Every frame moves the idea forward.
en.dc.typeText: Instrument Serif brings the expressiveness of a record-store sleeve. A cut groove and a needle form the mark. Vermilion, lilac, ink and warm white keep the sequence connected without repeating a layout.
en.dc.source3: The find / a hand in the record bin
en.dc.provenance: Made as an independent BYMOU concept for a fictional brand. Three photographic elements were created with the built-in ChatGPT image tool. The copy, glyph outlines, mark, crops and five compositions were authored separately. No client commission, published campaign or performance results are claimed.

fr.dc.label: CAMPAGNE SPÉCULATIVE / CINQ VISUELS
fr.dc.heading: La suite mérite votre attention.
fr.dc.description: DEEP CUT est un club de disques fictif qui invite à écouter vraiment. Une campagne qui transforme une accroche fugace en plaisir d’écouter toute une face.
fr.dc.disclosure: Marque fictive · Campagne spéculative BYMOU. Éléments photographiques IA ; typographie, identité et compositions originales.
fr.dc.explore: Dans les coulisses de la campagne
fr.dc.deck: De la première accroche au dernier sillon. Cinq compositions pour un club de disques fictif.
fr.dc.swipe: Balayez, utilisez les flèches ou sélectionnez le carrousel puis appuyez sur ← →.
fr.dc.context: Tout part d’une habitude : écouter l’accroche, puis passer à autre chose. DEEP CUT propose l’inverse. Écouter toute une face d’un disque, et laisser la curiosité faire le reste.
fr.dc.sequence: Une séquence qui donne envie de continuer.
fr.dc.fullsize: Ouvrez un visuel pour consulter le SVG en grand.
fr.dc.systemText: Une pochette accueille l’accroche. Un sillon devient une étiquette. Un cadrage circulaire suit une main dans un bac à disques. La photo cède ensuite la place au rituel d’écoute et à la signature. Chaque visuel fait avancer l’idée.
fr.dc.typeText: Instrument Serif apporte l’expressivité d’une pochette de disque. Un sillon ouvert et une aiguille composent le signe. Vermillon, lilas, encre et blanc chaud relient la séquence sans répéter une mise en page.
fr.dc.source1: La pochette / nature morte au flash
fr.dc.source3: La découverte / une main dans le bac
fr.dc.provenance: Concept indépendant BYMOU pour une marque fictive. Trois éléments photographiques ont été créés avec l’outil d’image intégré à ChatGPT. Les textes, tracés typographiques, signe, cadrages et cinq compositions ont été conçus séparément. Aucune commande client, campagne publiée ou performance commerciale n’est revendiquée.
fr.dc.contact: Une histoire qui mérite qu’on s’arrête ?

it.dc.label: CAMPAGNA SPECULATIVA / CINQUE VISUAL
it.dc.heading: C’è altro dopo il primo ascolto.
it.dc.description: DEEP CUT è un club di dischi immaginario dedicato all’ascolto attento. Una campagna che trasforma un richiamo fugace nel piacere di ascoltare un lato intero.
it.dc.disclosure: Brand immaginario · Campagna speculativa BYMOU. Elementi fotografici IA; tipografia, identità e composizioni originali.
it.dc.deck: Dal primo richiamo all’ultimo solco. Cinque composizioni per un club di dischi immaginario.
it.dc.swipe: Scorri, usa le frecce o seleziona il carosello e premi ← →.
it.dc.context: L’idea nasce da un’abitudine: ascoltare il ritornello e passare oltre. DEEP CUT invita al contrario. Dedica a un disco un lato intero e lascia fare alla curiosità.
it.dc.sequence: Una sequenza che invita a continuare.
it.dc.fullsize: Apri un visual per vedere il file SVG a grandezza naturale.
it.dc.systemText: Una copertina ospita il richiamo. Un solco diventa un’etichetta. Un ritaglio circolare segue una mano nel contenitore dei dischi. Poi la fotografia lascia spazio al rituale d’ascolto e al brand. Ogni visual porta avanti l’idea.
it.dc.typeText: Instrument Serif evoca l’espressività di una copertina. Un solco aperto e una puntina compongono il marchio. Vermiglio, lilla, inchiostro e bianco caldo legano la sequenza senza ripetere il layout.
it.dc.source1: La copertina / natura morta con flash
it.dc.source3: La scoperta / una mano tra i dischi
it.dc.provenance: Concept indipendente BYMOU per un brand immaginario. Tre elementi fotografici sono stati creati con lo strumento immagini integrato di ChatGPT. Testi, tracciati tipografici, marchio, ritagli e cinque composizioni sono stati realizzati separatamente. Nessuna commissione, campagna pubblicata o risultato commerciale viene dichiarato.

it.dc.title: DEEP CUT

projects.title: Coastal beauty
projects.description: An open road, a coastal setting and a skincare moment. A moving-image study of beauty in everyday life.
projects.focus: The contrast between open landscape and intimate product detail gives this film its rhythm.

projects.title: Beauty in motion
projects.description: A beauty and fragrance study, moving between portraiture, product and gesture.
projects.focus: Light, skin and the movement of a spray become the visual language of the film.

projects.title: Identity in motion
projects.description: An identity study in moving type. Letterforms become frames for a changing world of images.
projects.focus: Typography carries the image, bringing graphic composition and moving pictures into the same frame.

projects.title: Constructed worlds
projects.description: An architectural moving-image study through contemporary rooms, passages and interior details.
projects.focus: Space, material and the passage of light guide the eye through a constructed environment.

projects.title: A life in frames
projects.description: A fashion and lifestyle sequence set around contemporary architecture, a car and a figure in black.
projects.focus: A restrained palette connects the person, the architecture and the setting.

projects.title: Visual fragments
projects.description: A fast-moving collection of product, food, interiors and fashion imagery from the BYMOU archive.
projects.focus: An editorial montage explores the way very different visual worlds can share a rhythm.

projects.title: Everyday rituals
projects.description: Grooming, fashion, outdoor movement and water come together in a lifestyle film.
projects.focus: Small personal rituals are set against movement and open-air imagery.

projects.title: A taste of motion
projects.description: A food and product study featuring a protein snack, a dip and close-up textures.
projects.focus: The film brings attention to texture, colour and the small gestures of a food moment.

projects.title: Package ritual
projects.description: A creator-style package study built around a stack of labelled deliveries.
projects.focus: Packaging, anticipation and the visual language of a reveal.

projects.title: Digital windows
projects.description: A moving showcase of beauty, abstract, architectural and food-oriented digital compositions.
projects.focus: Different visual identities are brought together as a sequence of digital windows.
